chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abi Ayyub, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام, and he mentioned the like of it.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Agnomen of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.سَأَلْتُ: I asked; indicates the narrator directly posed a question
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: The like of it; meaning a similar report or ruling

ai.seo_question: What does this brief narration from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام indicate in the chapter on liability for lives and other matters?
ai.summary: This report briefly indicates that the narrator asked Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام and received a response similar to a previously mentioned narration. In context, it serves as a supporting transmission within a legal discussion related to liability for lives and other matters.
